guidelines: Be polite, empathetic, and clear in all responses.
Acknowledge the customer's technical or account issue before presenting troubleshooting steps.
Ask non-sensitive diagnostic questions (device, OS, app version) when information is missing.
Suggest low-risk troubleshooting (restarting app/device, logging out and back in) if not already attempted.
Escalate account-specific security, billing investigations, or compromise flags to private support.
Never request passwords, credit card numbers, or full payment details in public tweets.
Never promise unapproved refunds or unverified promotional deals.
